name: facebookresearch_craftassist/python/base_agent/dialogue_objects/AGENT.python.tools.md

facebookresearch_craftassist/python/base.interpret_span_value: interpret a dialogue span as a FixedValue using the interpreter and optional comparison measure
facebookresearch_craftassist/python/base.interpret_linear_extent: interpret a linear extent attribute with frame of reference, direction, and source or destination
facebookresearch_craftassist/python/base.maybe_specific_mem: resolve a reference object dictionary to a specific memory node or search data using filters and coreference
facebookresearch_craftassist/python/base.review_attribute_helper: review the attribute_helper module functions for interpreting span values, linear extents, and reference objects
facebookresearch_craftassist/python/base.refactor_interpret_linear_extent: refactor interpret_linear_extent to handle missing player frames and force_value logic more cleanly

facebookresearch_craftassist/python/base.interpret_condition: call ConditionInterpreter to parse a dialogue dict and return the appropriate Condition object
facebookresearch_craftassist/python/base.interpret_never_condition: use interpret_never to create a NeverCondition that always evaluates to false for the agent
facebookresearch_craftassist/python/base.interpret_and_condition: use interpret_and to build an AndCondition from a list of sub-conditions in the dialogue dict
facebookresearch_craftassist/python/base.interpret_or_condition: use interpret_or to build an OrCondition from a list of sub-conditions in the dialogue dict
facebookresearch_craftassist/python/base.interpret_comparator: use interpret_comparator to compare two values extracted from filters or spans with a given comparison type

facebookresearch_craftassist/python/base.create_dialogue_object_subclass: create a subclass of DialogueObject that implements the step method for custom bot dialogue behavior
facebookresearch_craftassist/python/base.use_awaitresponse_class: use the AwaitResponse class to wait for user chat input with a configurable timeout
facebookresearch_craftassist/python/base.use_say_class: use the Say class to send a random response from a list of options to the user
facebookresearch_craftassist/python/base.use_confirmtask_class: use the ConfirmTask class to ask the user a yes/no question and conditionally push tasks
facebookresearch_craftassist/python/base.use_botstackstatus_class: use the BotStackStatus class to report the bot current task like building or moving

facebookresearch_craftassist/python/base.coref_resolve: resolve coreferences in a dialogue logical form dict using memory and chat context
facebookresearch_craftassist/python/base.process_spans: process and substitute word spans in a dialogue dict with lemmatized tokens
facebookresearch_craftassist/python/base.tags_from_dict: extract tag strings from a dict by filtering keys that start with has_
facebookresearch_craftassist/python/base.is_loc_speakerlook: check if a location dict references the SPEAKER_LOOK special reference object
facebookresearch_craftassist/python/base.strip_prefix: strip a given prefix string from the start of another string if present
